section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for a single study involving 92 female undergraduate students (mean age 19.7 years, 50% Caucasian) who completed a longitudinal survey study with eight surveys. Participants were required to complete at least four of eight surveys, with a mean of 6.67 surveys completed. The sample was drawn from a college population.
